s1_netrev: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_netrev_p2: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_netrev_p3: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_aov: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_aov_p2: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_aov_p3: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_margin: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate) - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_active_cust: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_key) FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_active_p2: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_key) FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_active_p3: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_key) FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_gross_rev: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_orders: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s1_top_customer: SELECT o.customer_key, c.full_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_key = c.customer_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) GROUP BY o.customer_key, c.full_name ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 1
s2_shipping_total: SELECT SUM(o.shipping_fee) FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s2_shipping_region: SELECT o.ship_region, SUM(o.shipping_fee) FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) GROUP BY o.ship_region
s2_rev_and_ship: SELECT o.ship_region, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) as net_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.line_number = 1 THEN o.shipping_fee ELSE 0 END) as shipping_fees FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) GROUP BY o.ship_region
s2_lines: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s2_ship_pct: SELECT (SUM(o.shipping_fee) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate))) * 100 FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s2_avg_line_disc: SELECT AVG(o.shipping_fee) FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s3_refund_by_cat: SELECT p.category, SUM(r.refund_amount) FROM returns r JOIN order_items oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id AND r.line_number = oi.line_number JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key GROUP BY p.category
s3_net_of_refunds: SELECT (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(refund_amount) FROM returns), 0)
s3_refund_rev_by_cat: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) as net_revenue, SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)) as total_refunds FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key LEFT JOIN returns r ON oi.order_id = r.order_id AND oi.line_number = r.line_number WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) GROUP BY p.category
s5_ship_pct_region: SELECT o.ship_region, (SUM(CASE WHEN oi.line_number = 1 THEN o.shipping_fee ELSE 0 END) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate))) * 100 FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) GROUP BY o.ship_region
s7_vocab_paidsearch: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) AND o.channel IN ('paid_search', 'Paid-Search', 'PPC')
s7_vocab_paidsearch_orders: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) AND o.channel IN ('paid_search', 'Paid-Search', 'PPC')
s7_unans_age: SELECT NULL AS age_group, NULL::NUMERIC AS revenue
s7_unans_supplier: SELECT NULL AS supplier, NULL::NUMERIC AS revenue
s7_unans_weather: SELECT NULL AS weather, NULL::NUMERIC AS daily_sales
s7_ambiguous_sales: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (3, 4)
s7_ambiguous_best: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) as total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_key = p.product_key WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1
s8_rev_2024: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) AND date_trunc('year', o.order_ts) = '2024-01-01'
s8_rev_fy2024: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) AND date_trunc('year', o.order_ts + INTERVAL 11 MONTH) = '2024-01-01'
s8_rev_by_month: SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_ts) as month, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) AND date_trunc('year', o.order_ts) = '2024-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
s8_rev_2023: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_rate)) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status IN (3, 4) AND date_trunc('year', o.order_ts) = '2023-01-01'
